info.name: Health Habit Hub API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Health Habit Hub platform. Import this into Postman, set the `baseUrl` and `token` variables, then run any request.

For the Python Recommender Service spec, see: API-service/openapi.yaml

variable.description: Base URL for the HHH API
Keycloak JWT bearer token. Obtain from: POST /realms/hhh/protocol/openid-connect/token

request.description: Check health of all downstream services (neo4j, mongo, fuseki, keycloak, recommender). No authentication required.
Open Swagger UI in browser for interactive API documentation.
Raw OpenAPI 3.1 spec as JSON.
Get the authenticated user's profile. Returns 404 if no profile has been created yet.
Create or update the authenticated user's profile.

List surveys. Participants see published surveys according to targetMode: habit-donation is always available, group_assigned surveys are filtered by study group, unassigned_only surveys are shown only to participants without a group, and all_participants surveys are visible to everyone. Admins/researchers see all.
Get a single survey by ID or stable type alias including the SurveyJS JSON schema and targetMode.
Submit survey answers for the authenticated participant.
Get anonymized habit list with annotation counts for the habit graph visualization.
Get aggregate habit donation statistics: total count, by category, and daily activity over 30 days.
Add an anonymous annotation (helpful or iDoThis) to a habit. Returns updated counts.
Get personalized habit recommendations for a user (proxied to Python recommender).

response.name: 200 – Recommendations
response.body: [{"recommendationId":"rec-001","habitName":"Walk 30 minutes daily","rationale":"Based on your goal to exercise more","citation":"BCIO:0000042"}]

request.description: Get recommendation history (accepted + dismissed) for a user.

body.raw: {"text":"I go for a 30-minute walk every morning"}

request.description: Classify a habit text into a BCIO behavior category (proxied to Python classifier).
List all active (non-deleted) participants.
Create a new participant (Keycloak user + MongoDB record). Returns credentials and token card URL.
Assign participant to study group G1-G4 (updates MongoDB, Keycloak attributes, and Neo4j labels).
Download participant token card as PDF. format=qr|print|both (default: both).
Get participant progress: profile, surveys, habit count, recommendations, timeline.
Soft-delete a participant (sets deletedAt, anonymizes username). GDPR-safe.
List all surveys (all statuses). Admin/researcher only.
Create a new survey in draft status.
Update survey fields (any combination of title, type, jsonSchema, targetMode, assignedGroups, status).
Transition survey status: draft → published → archived.
Assign study groups to a survey and set its targetMode to group_assigned.
Paginated donated habits feed with optional filters.
Export donated habits as CSV file.
List all active Keycloak sessions in the hhh realm.
Revoke a Keycloak session, forcing the user to re-authenticate.
Get all admin configuration settings as a key-value map.
Update a single admin setting by key.
Anonymous self-registration. Creates a Keycloak participant account and immediately returns JWT tokens. Rate limited to 5 requests per IP per hour.

query.description: Optional: en or de — adds displayText field

request.description: Returns all Habit nodes (new schema) with uuid, original sentence, language, translationEN, translationDE. Add ?lang=en or ?lang=de for a displayText convenience field.

response.name: 200 – Habit list
response.body: [{"uuid":"3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6","original":"Ich gehe täglich 30 Minuten spazieren","language":"de","translationEN":"I walk for 30 minutes every day","translationDE":null,"displayText":"I walk for 30 minutes every day"}]

body.raw: {"sentence":"I go for a 30-minute walk every morning before breakfast","language":"en"}

request.description: Donates a habit through the three-stage pipeline: classify-habit → classify-context → map-bcio. Writes a Habit node to Neo4j with translationEN/DE fields.

response.name: 201 – Habit donated
response.body: {"is_habit":true,"uuid":"3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6","message":"Thank you! Your habit has been successfully donated."}

response.name: 200 – Not a habit
response.body: {"is_habit":false,"message":"Thank you for your contribution. This sentence was not identified as a habit and has been noted for review."}

request.description: List all active questionnaire definitions (slug, title, description, version, questionCount).
Get the full questionnaire definition (all questions and options) for the given slug.

response.name: 200 – Questionnaire
response.body: {"slug":"sliq","title":"Short Lifestyle Indicator Questions","version":"1.0","questions":[{"id":"sliq_diet","text":"How would you rate your diet?","type":"singleChoice"}]}

request.description: Submit answers for a questionnaire. Saved to the form_responses MongoDB collection.
Get all questionnaire responses submitted by the authenticated user, most recent first.
Get the most recent response for a specific questionnaire slug.
Get all past recommendations for the authenticated user with their feedback comments.

body.raw: {"comment":"This recommendation was very helpful for my morning routine"}

request.description: Submit free-text feedback for a recommendation. Also invalidates the Redis recommendation cache.
Get the authenticated user's preferences. Returns {userId, preferredLanguage:"en"} by default if no record exists.
Update user preferences. Currently supports preferredLanguage (en or de).
List all PDFs in the knowledge base (admin/researcher only). Proxied to API-service.
Upload a PDF to the knowledge base (admin/researcher only). Proxied to API-service.
Force full re-index of all knowledge base PDFs (admin/researcher only). Proxied to API-service.
Delete a PDF from the knowledge base by filename (admin/researcher only). Proxied to API-service.
